verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de is an incorporation platform, so obtaining a company tax ID is a fair question for it, but its evidence covers only German entities (UG/GmbH). Its tax-registration feature submits an ELSTER questionnaire to the German Finanzamt, which is a different, adjacent capability, not a US federal EIN. Nothing in the evidence shows it obtains an EIN.

support.subject: As a founder, I can obtain a federal EIN for my new company through the platform
